claim: Beat 1 and b1's caption print the middle position (0, 1) of the string through (2, 0) at node 1 of A2 with the path of a weight of another representation, the orbit of the fundamental position of node 2, whose positions do not include (2, 0). Beat 6 says 'E8, F4 and G2 have no minuscule node: their Cartan matrices have determinant <G k="types.E8.det_cartan"/>', so the path names one of the three boards the sentence names. Both print the right digits only by coincidence. The lesson already computes the string with the engine (export const STRING_TWO = stringThrough(A2, [2, 0], 0), never used).
expected: SPEC 7.3: <G> exists 'so prose cannot drift from the data'. The lens rule: a path whose board or field differs from the sentence is a finding even when the digits agree.
